title: Split the kcd2_dice_solver test files under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring every kcd2 test file under the cap by partitioning at describe boundaries, taking the package from twelve violations to four source files.
acceptance_criteria: No kcd2_dice_solver test file is over 250 lines.
The suite still reports exactly 288 passing tests -- the same as before the split, though spread across 24 files instead of 15.
Coverage stays at 100% for statements, branches, functions and lines.
npm run lint passes with no new suppression and no eslint-disable.
A fixture shared by two split halves goes in src/test/, which vite.config.ts excludes from coverage. A fixture placed beside the source would be counted as production code and break the 100% gate.
No test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole describe blocks move verbatim.
No empty test file is left behind: a file whose last describe moved out is removed, since vitest fails on 'No test suite found'.
out_of_scope: search.ts, scoring.ts, badgeValue.ts and App.tsx, which are source files.
verifier: npm test -- --run (expects exactly 288 passed), npm run coverage (100% on all four metrics), npm run lint, and check_file_length.sh over kcd2_dice_solver.
